Writing compact QA — 2026-10-12

Local browser fixture renders the actual WritingPractice component with the existing
writingSentences and evaluateWritingSentence modules. No authenticated access bypass,
paid request, database mutation or evaluation-service replacement was used.

Viewport       Horizontal overflow   Next visible after 90% result
375 x 667      No                    Yes (bottom 626 px)
390 x 844      No                    Yes (bottom 616 px)
360 x 800      No                    Yes (bottom 626 px)
768 x 1024     No                    Yes (bottom 528 px)
1366 x 768     No                    Yes (bottom 534 px)
1920 x 1080    No                    Yes (bottom 534 px)

All six: typed answer, verified, score and capitalization feedback visible, then
Next cleared the draft and removed the previous result. No horizontal overflow.
Additional checks: exact answer 100%; added negation 40% with retry; retry preserves
draft; portrait/landscape preserves draft; Tab/Enter submits; result receives focus;
translation starts closed and expands; shared speech function reported completion.

Limitations: viewport simulation is not physical iOS/Android testing. Real virtual
keyboard behavior, screen-reader speech output and human auditory quality were not
verified. Semantic AI service was not called; its existing integration is unchanged.
The fixture has a representative shell, not the complete signed-in production shell.

Residency: supplied Speaking/no-speaking files match public/interviewer assets by
SHA-256. The browser voice controller now waits for utterance.onstart before entering
speaking; completion/cancel returns to the listening video. Covered by voice tests.
